caption:
Stop scrubbing your air fryer basket every single night.

Grease and crumbs settle into every ridge of a non-stick basket, and just rinsing it doesn't lift them out. Scrubbing those ridges with a brush or sponge night after night slowly wears down the coating. Most of that mess never touches the food, it just sits between the basket and the heating element.

These are precut 8 inch square parchment liners made for 5 to 8 quart baskets, so grease and crumbs land on the paper instead of the basket. They're rated 4.6 stars across roughly 34,000 reviews, which points to a lot of people using them the same way.

One liner goes in, the mess comes out with it, and the basket underneath stays the way it was before. The pack runs about $8.
